title: Intake record
description: What GET /api/dev/scaffold/:id returns and `agentsmith tenant init --from <id>` scaffolds from (.agent-rfc/designs/portal-intake-pull.md). A change to this shape is a v2, never an edit to v1. The portal validates it for the author's convenience; the CLI re-validates every field against its own constants, and that is the control.

tenant_id.description: portal/lib/apps.ts APP_ID — narrower than runtime/cli.py TENANT_ID_PATTERN, so the tenant can register as a portal app.

architecture.description: A structural style or null. Checked against templates/architectures.yaml by the CLI only; the portal checks its shape.

ides.description: scripts/gate_ides.py GENERATED. Empty means every IDE with a verified config schema.
